reviews.body: Thank you for the contribution @pcbeingused333. I think this doesn't exactly resolve the specific example in #746 but doing so would require some changes on Connect. For other cases where deletion fails and Connect reports an error, this change would catch it appropriately, however I think we should move handling to `delete_runtime_cache`.

review_comments.body:
Instead of handling this here could we instead make the change in `delete_runtime_cache`?  I think we just need to remove `raise_on_error=False`

https://github.com/posit-dev/rsconnect-python/blob/6afd927d68407f1a09d9c41da3c0a92c17de3b0d/rsconnect/api.py#L3003

comments.body: Makes sense, thanks. Pushed a follow-up: `delete_runtime_cache` no longer passes `raise_on_error=False`, so `wait_for_task` raises on a non-zero task code, and the extra check in `system_caches_delete` is removed. The CLI test now expects `Task exited with status 1.` and exit code 1. Agreed this doesn't cover the exact example in #746 without Connect changes; I've reworded the description accordingly.
